name: _tokens.scss
html:
// ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
//  cms/_tokens.scss — CMS token publication + document base: the
//  :host/:root custom properties the CMS document needs (it never loads
//  _structure.scss), plus html/body and the .cms-container shell.
//  Imported by cms.scss (manifest) — not compiled standalone.
// ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

// ── Token Publication ─────────────────────────────────────────────────
// The public site publishes its design tokens on :root via _structure.scss.
// The CMS document never loads that file — without this block every
// var(--radius-*), var(--font-primary) and var(--text-primary) inside a
// component's shadow DOM resolves to nothing (serif fallback + black text on
// dark panels). Custom properties set on :host inherit into the shadow tree;
// :root additionally covers the document when this sheet is linked page-wide.
:host,
:root {
  --font-primary: 'Raleway', sans-serif;
  --text-primary: #{$cms-text-primary};

  --skel-bg-1: #{$cms-bg-card};
  --skel-bg-2: #{$cms-bg-dark};

  --radius-none: 0;
  --radius-hairline: var(--space-hairline);
  --radius-2xs: var(--space-2xs);
  --radius-xs: var(--space-xs);
  --radius-sm: var(--space-sm);
  --radius-md: var(--space-md);
  --radius-lg: var(--space-lg);
  --radius-xl: var(--space-xl);
  --radius-full: 50%;
  --radius-round: 9999px;

  // Spacing tokens (Fibonacci scale) — rem lengths, mirrors _structure.scss
  // so component sheets can use var(--space-*) without compile-time imports.
  // These stay literal rem values: a var() can alias ANOTHER token (like
  // --radius-* above) but never itself — self-reference is cyclic and
  // resolves to nothing at computed-value time.
  --space-none: #{$space-none};
  --space-hairline: #{to-rem($space-hairline)};
  --space-pixel: #{to-rem($space-pixel)};
  --space-3xs: #{to-rem($space-3xs)};
  --space-2xs: #{to-rem($space-2xs)};
  --space-xs: #{to-rem($space-xs)};
  --space-sm: #{to-rem($space-sm)};
  --space-md: #{to-rem($space-md)};
  --space-lg: #{to-rem($space-lg)};
  --space-xl: #{to-rem($space-xl)};
  --space-2xl: #{to-rem($space-2xl)};
  --space-3xl: #{to-rem($space-3xl)};
  --space-4xl: #{to-rem($space-4xl)};
  --space-5xl: #{to-rem($space-5xl)};
  --space-6xl: #{to-rem($space-6xl)};
  --space-7xl: #{to-rem($space-7xl)};
  --space-8xl: #{to-rem($space-8xl)};
  --space-9xl: #{to-rem($space-9xl)};
  --space-10xl: #{to-rem($space-10xl)};

  --z-top: #{$z-top};
}

// ── Document base ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// Applies only where the compiled sheet is linked at page level
// (cms/index.html); shadow-DOM copies ignore it harmlessly.
html {
  background-color: $cms-bg-darkest;
}

body {
  margin: 0;
  min-height: 100vh;
  background-color: $cms-bg-darkest;
  color: $cms-text-primary;
  font-family: 'Raleway', sans-serif;
  -webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased;
}

#cms {
  min-height: 100vh;
}

// ── CMS & Admin Theme System ─────────────────────────────────────────

// Shared box-sizing reset for the CMS shell + login screen.
.cms-container,

// Centered login layout.
.admin-login-wrapper {
  box-sizing: border-box;

  *,
  *::before,
  *::after {
    box-sizing: border-box;
  }
}

// CMS page shell — full-height dark console background.
.cms-container {
  min-height: 100vh;
  background-color: $cms-bg-darkest;
  color: $cms-text-primary;
  font-family:
    'Raleway',
    system-ui,
    -apple-system,
    sans-serif;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
}
